title: Primary-equivalent corrosion protection of post-consumer scrap based aluminium
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,1367-1375
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00350D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Erlind Mysliu, John Erik Lein, Per Erik Vullum, Jan Tore Buvik Gundersen, Malgorzata Chojak Halseid, Otto Lunder, Andreas Erbe
With appropriate pretreatment, aluminium alloys based on post-consumer scrap with slightly increased zinc and copper content can safely be powder coated while still fulfilling industrial requirements of filiform corrosion resistance.
